resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list and a Friends of Finland post both record the tower as removed in 2026. An OpenStreetMap point, last edited about six years ago, predates the removal and is not treated as evidence the tower still stands.

notes_for_editor: Removal is confirmed by a Friends of Finland post (July 2026) and the FFLA list. Height 120 ft is from the state list; the record had none. No staffing, fire or agency history was found for this tower. Tower #107 (moved to Askov in 1951) is a different structure. The Friends of Finland photos of the demolition were not readable from the cache, so none are added. The Friends post does not say what remains on the site.
